id: Rotom Dex: Let's head back home. It looks like the Ultra Beast is taken care of.
en: Rotom Dex: Let's head back home. It looks like the Ultra Beast is taken care of.
it: Rotom Dex: Torniamo a casa. Sembra che dell'Ultracreatura si sia occupato qualcuno.

id: \rJessie: We should be able to use this nectar for something.
en: \rJessie: We should be able to use this nectar for something.
it: \rJessie: Questo nettare dovrebbe tornarci utile per qualcosa.

id: \bJames: Still, should we just be stealing it? Couldn't we just buy some?
en: \bJames: Still, should we just be stealing it? Couldn't we just buy some?
it: \bJames: Però, dobbiamo per forza rubarlo? Non potremmo comprarne un po'?

id: \bMeowth: We're Team Rocket. Of course we have to steal it!
en: \bMeowth: We're Team Rocket. Of course we have to steal it!
it: \bMeowth: Siamo il Team Rocket. Certo che dobbiamo rubarlo!
